translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús dule-argan-burgwaled-nudaksad
Ibagwengi Jesús Judiomar-onmaked-neggi dognonibalid. Agine, dule-wargwen argan-burgwaled sii-gusmogad.
Jesús-istarmalad-bukidar Jesús-argabukwa-gusmalad, dakegar, bule obunnoged-ibagi Jesús dule-nudako-dibeye, adi egi sunmakmalagar, obunnoged-igar-maidgi annadiiye.
Jesús dule-argan-burgwaledga sogded: —Dage, abarse gwisguda.

Degi Jesús dulemar-e-dakbukwadga sogded: —¿Wede igar-nuedi obunnoged-ibagi ibmar-nued-imaked, igi, ibmar-iskana-imaked? ¿Igid bur-nabiri, dule-odurgued, igi, dule-oburgwed? ¿Igi bemar sogsunna? Dule-gwensaksaar abin-imaksasulid, bela boo ambikusmalad.

Jesús undar saebaksar itos, ulubgi nue bukib-binsa emar-dakded, ar ade nue-akusunna itomalad Bab Dummad dulemar-sabed. Degine, wile-emar-daked gwen niksurmarbalid, unnila bur-bule igar-maidba dabimalad. Jesús dule-argan-burgwaledga sogdesun: —Be-argan onak. Dule e-argan-onakwidgu, e-argan yog nuguar naded.
Fariseomar Judiomar-onmaked-neggi sii noargu, Herodes-sordamar-ebo igar-amiarmalad, igi-saele Jesús-oburgwemalo-dibeye.
Dule-bukidar mata-dummad-gakaba Jesúsba nade-gusad
Jesús na e-sapinganmala mata-dummad-gakase nade-gusad. Bukidar-Galilea-dorgan eba nade-gusmarmogad.

Jesús ibmar-dakledisurmalad imakdiiye wisguarmargu, Judeaginmalad, Jerusalénginmalad, Idumea-dorgan, Jordán-diwar-gakabarmalad, Tiro-yarginmalad, degi, Sidón-neggweburginmaladse-bakar nonimalad, Jesús-dakegar.
Degisoggu, aga Jesús e-sapinganga sogsasunnad: —Anga guar ur nasikmalo, ar dulemar an-ebugega na barmesnanai-guarmalale, idu urgi an nakwegar, adi mer an-sarwemalagar.
Ar ibigala, ade Jesús dule-bukidar-nudakdisoggu, dule-uelemalad Jesús-ebugega na barmesnanai-guar-damalad, nudaklegegar.
Degine, niaburba-dule-ichodimalad, Jesús-dakalile, sindigar yokorgi yog sigis-damalad, geb degi Jesúsga binnasur sogde-damalad: —¡Be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid!
Jesús niamarga sogde-daed: —Dulemar-abargi mer an-barsogmar, an doa-dule.
Jesús, e-ambe-gakabo susad, e-barmilearmaladga guegar
A-sorbali Jesús yar-birse naded. Doamar ese dagbi abesa, amarse gochad. Amar bela ese ambikunonimargu,
geb degi Jesús e-ambe-gakabo susad, adi eba nanaegar. Amar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba barsogega onugsalesbalid.
Degi Jesús amarga gangued uksabalid, adi niamar-oniegar. Amar apóstolesye-bilesad, a sogleged, Jesús-nuggi-barmilenanaidye.
Jesús-e-ambe-gakabo-susad, wemardo: Simón, a Pedroye Jesús onugsasbalid.
Santiago, degine, e-urba Juan, Zebedeo-machimala; a-machimalade baisursunna ulud-daed. Degisoggu, Jesús, Boanergesye onugsasbardo, a sogleged, mar-goled-machimalaye.
Degine, Andrés, Felipe, Bartolomé, Mateo, Tomás, degi, Santiago, Alfeo-machi, aginbali, Tadeo, Simón, a-dule cananista-sordad,
degi, Judas-Iscariote, darba-Jesús-uksad-dule.
Jesús nia-saila-sogedba niamar-onodiiye-nik sogmalad
A-sorba Jesús na e-sapinganmala negse dognonimalad. Dulemar-bukidar gannar ese ambikunonisoggu, geg mas gunne-guarmalad.
E-gwenadgan wisguarmargu, Jesús-sedega armalad, ar ade sogmalad, wis dargwen-ito an dakye.
Escribamar-Jerusalénba-danimalad, sogdemalad: —Jesúsgi Beelzebú nai, nia-saila. Degi sogmarbalid: —Nia-saila ega gangued uksad, adi na e-nuggi niamar-oniegar.
Jesús, escribamar degi-soge itosgu, ese gochad, dagmarye. Ese nonimargu, Jesús burbar amarga sunmakded, sogded: “¿Nia-saila-Satanás na e-sordamar sunna onogo be insae? Adi suli.
Deginbali, rey-gwensak na neggwebur-dakmaid, igi-dibe, e-sordamar dukin-dukin na egi aibinnarmar-dibe, ¿we-neggwebur bergussulir be insae? Bergudele.
“Aginbali, dulemar-na-neg-yagi-gudimalad, egi dukin-dukin na aibinnarmalale, ¿we-neg bergussulir be insae? We-neg bergudele.
Debayobi nia-saila-Satanás na e-sordamargi aibitele, e-igar-mamaid bergudo-itole.

“Emigindi an bega sogmaloed, ibiga nabir niamar an onie. Ar dule-dutusulid e-neggi siile, dule-wargwen geg e-negse doged ei-ibmar atursaegar, ar bina edingweler-gebed, geb degi ei-ibmar atursaodo. Ar an deyobmodo, ar nia-sailagi an nakwisadba, sunna emi an niamar-onidiid.
“Degisoggu, napira an bemarga soged, galagwensuli be iskudii-dibe, ar amba galagwensuli Bab Dummadgi dodoar be sunmakdi-dibe, ar ase-bakar sunna Bab Dummad bega be-iskudiid elioed.

Ar doa-dule Bab Dummad Burba Nuedgi galagwensuli egi dodoar sunmaksardi, adi e-iskusad Bab Dummad gege ega elied, ar a-iskusaddi degi-eba-sadeguoed. Degisoggu, mer Bab Dummad Burba Nuedgi galagwensuli be sunmakmalo, degine, mer egi dodomarbalo.”
Jesús wegi-sogsa-gusdo, ar ade nik-sogmalad, Jesús niaburba-nikye, a-nuggi niamar-onodiiye.
Jesús-e-nan, degi, Jesús-e-urbamar Jesús-aminonimalad
Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, e-nan, degine, Jesús-urbamar Jesússe nonimalad. Neg-magaba gwisgunonimargu, dulemarga sogded: “Jesúsga soge, ‘Be-gwenadgan magaba be-edarbebukye.’ ”
Dulemar-Jesús-dikarba-bukmalad ega sogded: —Be-nan, degine, be-urbamar magaba be-edarbebukmalad.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —¿Doamar an-nana, degi, an-urbamala?
Jesús dulemar-e-dikarba-bukwad-dakdegu, sogded: —Wemar an-nangan, degine, wemar an-urbamar.
Ar doa-dule Bab-Dummad-igar-maidba daele, a-dulemar an-urbamalad, an-bunmalad, degi, an-nanganad.
